title: Rising Tension (snack)
author: jobs2554
rules:
- Classic fillomino rules apply. Devide the white cells into regions and fill the cells in each region with the size of that region. No two adjacent region may have the same size.

- Draw a path from the circle to the diamond that visits every white cell. Adjacent numbers on the path must either stay the same or increase by one from the circle to the diamond.
